ignoreValues.reason: Email-safe HTML requires Arial/Helvetica fallback fonts for client compatibility (Outlook/Gmail/Apple Mail don't render custom web fonts in email) — this is the correct, required practice for transactional/marketing email, not a web-app typography choice. Pre-existing convention throughout this file, not introduced by this change.

Left gold accent border (border-left:2px solid gold) is this app's established campaign-email design language, already used for event_details/finalists/lead/program blocks before this change. User explicitly praised this exact look (the (Ver-)Erben campaign) and asked the new news block to match it.
Same accent-border pattern as campaign-renderer.ts (React mirror of the same email templates) — established design language the user confirmed liking; see reason on campaign-renderer.ts ignore.
